Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Preserve historically plausible Roman architecture and dress; interpretive reconstruction rather than pretending to be an ancient photograph. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.

Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. warm morning sunlight from upper camera-left, cooler sky fill, bright edges and rich open shadows. Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.
Shot 032. Scene: High oblique cinematic insert from the SIDE of a Roman satirist's small wooden writing desk. The lower edge includes only a corner of burgundy sleeve and one relaxed hand beside an open papyrus roll, NOT two viewer hands. The seated person's entire head and face are completely OUTSIDE the image. The hero is the worn papyrus and bronze oil lamp, with rough plaster and a small window deep behind. Camera looks diagonally down across the desk, natural ancient writing texture too small to read. Dense tactile material detail, no invented readable quotation, no central person, no portrait.
Composition: HIGH OBLIQUE INSERT 65mm. Foreground: sleeve corner and papyrus. Midground: one hand and bronze oil lamp on the desk, entire head outside frame. Background: narrow room and small window. Hero subject: 두루마리, clearly readable near the center third. Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. motivated warm oil-lamp light from lower left, very low cool ambient fill, deep dimensional shadows. Reserve a coherent central or near-central travel path. Image must stand alone with lush but purposeful surrounding detail.

image_prompt:
LATEST USER CINEMATOGRAPHY REQUIREMENT: a composed live-action historical MOVIE still with shot-specific cinematic camera placement, NOT a fixed first-person game view, NOT a repeated behind-avatar game camera, no game HUD. Wide oblique aerial, low-angle architecture, telephoto layers, dynamic diagonal composition, intimate object close-ups and macro details alternate across the sequence. Do not automatically insert the viewer's arms or hands. Human fragments belong only when the stated story action needs them. No face-forward speaking presenter, talking head or frontal face close-up. Featured people are beautifully costumed but viewed from behind, cropped to shoulder/torso/hands, or hidden behind a motivated foreground element. Make spectacular surrounding architecture, fabric, flora and daily activity abundant yet compositionally controlled. A purposeful object, garment detail, horse, bird or other explicitly specified anchor may guide a later cinematic transition; never insert animals indiscriminately. Natural depth through camera placement, overlapping planes, visual scale and lighting. Use case: historical-scene (scientific and modern-research inserts as explicitly specified). Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Preserve historically plausible Roman architecture and dress; interpretive reconstruction rather than pretending to be an ancient photograph. No copied source-image people, watermarks, brands, interface, lettering, subtitles, fake inscriptions, fantasy armor, baroque rococo interiors, electric lights, modern cranes, Aurelian walls or Arch of Constantine in AD 117. No excessive bloom, uniformly orange grading, flat gray ruins, plastic faces or indiscriminate fog. Still image, no motion blur on the focal subject. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.

Composition: GROUND WIDE 24mm. Foreground: 방패 가장자리. Midground: 전진 병사. Background: 요새. Hero subject: 산악 요새, clearly readable near the center third. Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. cool mountainous daylight with warm side-back sun, worn metal reflections and red wool accents. Reserve a coherent central or near-central travel path. Image must stand alone with lush but purposeful surrounding detail.

LATEST USER CINEMATOGRAPHY REQUIREMENT: a composed live-action historical MOVIE still with shot-specific cinematic camera placement, NOT a fixed first-person game view, NOT a repeated behind-avatar game camera, no game HUD. Wide oblique aerial, low-angle architecture, telephoto layers, dynamic diagonal composition, intimate object close-ups and macro details alternate across the sequence. Do not automatically insert the viewer's arms or hands. Human fragments belong only when the stated story action needs them. No face-forward speaking presenter, talking head or frontal face close-up. Featured people are beautifully costumed but viewed from behind, cropped to shoulder/torso/hands, or hidden behind a motivated foreground element. Make spectacular surrounding architecture, fabric, flora and daily activity abundant yet compositionally controlled. A purposeful object, garment detail, horse, bird or other explicitly specified anchor may guide a later cinematic transition; never insert animals indiscriminately. Natural depth through camera placement, overlapping planes, visual scale and lighting. Use case: historical-scene (scientific and modern-research inserts as explicitly specified). Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Preserve historically plausible Roman architecture and dress; interpretive reconstruction rather than pretending to be an ancient photograph. No copied source-image people, watermarks, brands, interface, lettering, subtitles, fake inscriptions, fantasy armor, baroque rococo interiors, electric lights, modern cranes, Aurelian walls or Arch of Constantine in AD 117. No excessive bloom, uniformly orange grading, flat gray ruins, plastic faces or indiscriminate fog. Still image, no motion blur on the focal subject. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.

Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. warm upper-left sunlight, luminous colored marble, bronze highlights, deep cool portico shadows. Reserve a coherent central or near-central travel path. Image must stand alone with lush but purposeful surrounding detail.

image_prompt:
LATEST USER CINEMATOGRAPHY REQUIREMENT: a composed live-action historical MOVIE still with shot-specific cinematic camera placement, NOT a fixed first-person game view, NOT a repeated behind-avatar game camera, no game HUD. Wide oblique aerial, low-angle architecture, telephoto layers, dynamic diagonal composition, intimate object close-ups and macro details alternate across the sequence. Do not automatically insert the viewer's arms or hands. Human fragments belong only when the stated story action needs them. No face-forward speaking presenter, talking head or frontal face close-up. Featured people are beautifully costumed but viewed from behind, cropped to shoulder/torso/hands, or hidden behind a motivated foreground element. Make spectacular surrounding architecture, fabric, flora and daily activity abundant yet compositionally controlled. A purposeful object, garment detail, horse, bird or other explicitly specified anchor may guide a later cinematic transition; never insert animals indiscriminately. Natural depth through camera placement, overlapping planes, visual scale and lighting. Use case: historical-scene (scientific and modern-research inserts as explicitly specified). Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Preserve historically plausible Roman architecture and dress; interpretive reconstruction rather than pretending to be an ancient photograph. No copied source-image people, watermarks, brands, interface, lettering, subtitles, fake inscriptions, fantasy armor, baroque rococo interiors, electric lights, modern cranes, Aurelian walls or Arch of Constantine in AD 117. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.

Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. precise macro raking illumination, natural mineral colors, crisp physical textures. Reserve a coherent central or near-central travel path. Image must stand alone with lush but purposeful surrounding detail.

Wide oblique aerial, low-angle architecture, telephoto layers, dynamic diagonal composition, intimate object close-ups and macro details alternate across the sequence. Do not automatically insert the viewer's arms or hands. Human fragments belong only when the stated story action needs them. No face-forward speaking presenter, talking head or frontal face close-up. Featured people are beautifully costumed but viewed from behind, cropped to shoulder/torso/hands, or hidden behind a motivated foreground element. Make spectacular surrounding architecture, fabric, flora and daily activity abundant yet compositionally controlled. A purposeful object, garment detail, horse, bird or other explicitly specified anchor may guide a later cinematic transition; never insert animals indiscriminately. Natural depth through camera placement, overlapping planes, visual scale and lighting. Use case: historical-scene (scientific and modern-research inserts as explicitly specified). Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. luminous atrium daylight from upper left, rich cinnabar and blue frescoes, subtle gold and glass reflections. LATEST USER CINEMATOGRAPHY REQUIREMENT: a composed live-action historical MOVIE still with shot-specific cinematic camera placement, NOT a fixed first-person game view, NOT a repeated behind-avatar game camera, no game HUD. Wide oblique aerial, low-angle architecture, telephoto layers, dynamic diagonal composition, intimate object close-ups and macro details alternate across the sequence. Do not automatically insert the viewer's arms or hands. Human fragments belong only when the stated story action needs them. No face-forward speaking presenter, talking head or frontal face close-up. Featured people are beautifully costumed but viewed from behind, cropped to shoulder/torso/hands, or hidden behind a motivated foreground element. Make spectacular surrounding architecture, fabric, flora and daily activity abundant yet compositionally controlled. A purposeful object, garment detail, horse, bird or other explicitly specified anchor may guide a later cinematic transition; never insert animals indiscriminately. Natural depth through camera placement, overlapping planes, visual scale and lighting. Use case: historical-scene (scientific and modern-research inserts as explicitly specified). Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Preserve historically plausible Roman architecture and dress; interpretive reconstruction rather than pretending to be an ancient photograph. No copied source-image people, watermarks, brands, interface, lettering, subtitles, fake inscriptions, fantasy armor, baroque rococo interiors, electric lights, modern cranes, Aurelian walls or Arch of Constantine in AD 117. No excessive bloom, uniformly orange grading, flat gray ruins, plastic faces or indiscriminate fog. Still image, no motion blur on the focal subject. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.
Shot 092. Scene: Sweeping cinematic aerial-oblique view over an immense arid Roman eastern supply road, a sharp near rocky ridge gives way to a tiny convoy and widely spaced outposts in immense cool atmospheric distance. No first-person arms, no avatar. Powerful height, diagonals, sunlight raking the terrain and physically layered depth. 
Composition: AERIAL EW 35mm 능선 사선. Foreground: 길가 수레. Midground: 먼 병력. Background: 끝없는 지형. Hero subject: 긴 보급로, clearly readable near the center third. Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. low warm sun over dry eastern terrain, immense cool atmospheric distance. Reserve a coherent central or near-central travel path. Image must stand alone with lush but purposeful surrounding detail.

image_prompt:
LATEST USER CINEMATOGRAPHY REQUIREMENT: a composed live-action historical MOVIE still with shot-specific cinematic camera placement, NOT a fixed first-person game view, NOT a repeated behind-avatar game camera, no game HUD. Wide oblique aerial, low-angle architecture, telephoto layers, dynamic diagonal composition, intimate object close-ups and macro details alternate across the sequence. Do not automatically insert the viewer's arms or hands. Human fragments belong only when the stated story action needs them. No face-forward speaking presenter, talking head or frontal face close-up. Featured people are beautifully costumed but viewed from behind, cropped to shoulder/torso/hands, or hidden behind a motivated foreground element. Make spectacular surrounding architecture, fabric, flora and daily activity abundant yet compositionally controlled. A purposeful object, garment detail, horse, bird or other explicitly specified anchor may guide a later cinematic transition; never insert animals indiscriminately. Natural depth through camera placement, overlapping planes, visual scale and lighting. Use case: historical-scene (scientific and modern-research inserts as explicitly specified). Asset type: ONE independent full-frame cinematic documentary still, landscape 16:9, target 1536x864 or the closest supported high-quality landscape resolution. Never a collage, storyboard sheet, contact sheet, poster, screenshot, caption card or multiple panels. Premium photographic realism with tangible linen, rope, timber, skin, brick, stone and metal. Beautifully abundant surroundings organized into three readable depth layers; a strong single focal subject, a clear travel corridor and visible human scale when architectural. Color inspiration: jewel-like teal and emerald accents, cinnabar and terracotta, Egyptian blue, luminous ivory and controlled bronze-gold highlights, deep dimensional shadows with recoverable texture. Preserve historically plausible Roman architecture and dress; interpretive reconstruction rather than pretending to be an ancient photograph. No copied source-image people, watermarks, brands, interface, lettering, subtitles, fake inscriptions, fantasy armor, baroque rococo interiors, electric lights, modern cranes, Aurelian walls or Arch of Constantine in AD 117. No excessive bloom, uniformly orange grading, flat gray ruins, plastic faces or indiscriminate fog. Still image, no motion blur on the focal subject. Lens values are compositional intent, not claims of real camera metadata.

Composition: HIGH WIDE 35mm. Foreground: 저택 테라스. Midground: 대저택. Background: 낮은 도시의 인술라. Hero subject: 주거 선택, clearly readable near the center third. Depth comes from actual near/far camera placement, perspective, occlusion, scale and atmospheric separation, never merely digital zoom. low golden evening sun and sparse warm practical oil lamps against deep blue ambient shadows.
